name: starlight-foundry
description: Design portable skills and bounded agent systems, with an optional compile-and-proof handoff to a Starlight Foundry runtime.

interface.longDescription: Design typed Task Envelopes, reusable skills, bounded agents, multi-capability systems, and evidence plans. In a Starlight Intelligence System workspace, the same skills can hand off to the Foundry compiler and prover; a skills-only marketplace install reports runtime proof as pending instead of inventing a receipt.
defaultPrompt: Turn this repeated workflow into a reusable skill.
Decide whether this needs a skill, tool, or persistent agent.
Define evidence and quality gates for this capability.
